title: Photographer Discovers Train Part That Could Hold Key to Spain Train Crash
summary: Officials said they had located a previously unreported train undercarriage down a gully near the site of a train crash in Spain that killed 42 people. Experts said the finding could help investigators clarify what caused the disaster.

title: A Few Dozen European Troops in Greenland Set Off Trump
summary: President Trump threatened tariffs on European nations that sent military personnel to Greenland last week. Some have already gone home, but Denmark is now sending about 100 more.
